summary: Evaxion A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting resolutions passed at its Annual General Meeting on April 16, 2026. Shareholders representing 25.15% of outstanding shares voted. Items included election of chairman, approval of audited annual report, re-election of directors and auditor, election of a new board member, and authorization for the board to issue warrants up to DKK 11,900,000 until April 15, 2029. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring was announced. This is a routine corporate governance filing.
